en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European riverside town. A broad river with several boats and a paddle steamer runs through the foreground, bordered by stone embankments and sandy banks. On the left rises a large hilltop complex resembling a castle or palace, with long multi‑story wings and turrets overlooking the town. Below are dense clusters of traditional gabled houses. In the mid‑distance stands a large church with a tall central tower and steep roof dominating the skyline. Rolling hills form the background. No printed or handwritten text is visible on the image itself.
